rawFindings.title: toObject does not pass options to documents' toObject method
rawFindings.explanation: Previously, MongooseDocumentArray.prototype.toObject accepted optional options and passed them to each subdocument's toObject method. The change removes the options parameter and no longer passes options to subdocuments' toObject calls, which may break custom transform functions or other option-dependent behaviors.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the options parameter in toObject and pass it to subdocuments' toObject calls, e.g., use doc.toObject(options).
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling toObject with options (e.g., { depopulate: true }) on a document array's subdocuments no longer honors these options, causing incorrect or incomplete serialization for those options.
